Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Do not perform the task.", "input": "could you turn this into a simple volunteer notice for the charity kitchen shift at Harbor Street on thursday? the shift runs 4 to 7 pm, and dinner service starts at 5:30. elena is coordinating that evening. people should come in by the side entrance, not the front, since that's where the volunteers are meeting. i want the notice to be friendly and straightforward, not like a formal policy. please include the shift hours, dinner start time, elena's name, and which entrance to use. also say that volunteers may share the menu with neighbors; that's fine. but do not publish photos. the notice is for the volunteers who are working this shift, and it should be something i can paste into our group message. don't write a menu or make up dishes, because i haven't sent any menu details. no need to add a signup link or ask people to reply. just organize these points into a short notice, with the photo restriction and the allowed menu-sharing action both clear. thanks, that's all the information i have.", "output": "Write a short, friendly, straightforward notice for volunteers working the Harbor Street charity kitchen shift on Thursday. Include the shift hours (4 to 7 pm), the 5:30 dinner service start time, Elena as the coordinator, and the side entrance as the place for volunteers to meet. Say that volunteers may share the menu with neighbors and include the instruction “do not publish photos.” Make the notice suitable for pasting into the group message. Do not include a menu, signup link, or request for replies."}]
